name: Almoharín (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Almoharín (a castle on red between trees on yellow).
history: The arms and the flag of Almoharín were approved by the Order of 6 November 1995 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 23 November 1995, after the municipal council's approval on 27 April 1995.
